To block potential threats and continue building toward a winning line in this 3D Connect Four variant, taking control of the center is essential. Looking at the L1 layer, column B row 2 currently has an O piece, and dropping in B2 will stack directly on top of it, advancing your presence upward.

MOVE: drop B2

Looking at the board, your O pieces are currently positioned to build toward a winning line, and X just twisted row 1 right. To prevent X from setting up traps or to advance your own positioning while adhering to the rule that you cannot undo X's exact previous move ("twist row 1 right"), making a strategic drop is a solid choice. 

Let's drop a piece at B3 to secure more control near your existing O at L1-B3.

MOVE: drop B3
